rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a solemn pledge or promise, especially in formal or emotional contexts.

example.english: I made an oath before the priest that I would take good care of my family.
example.traditional: 我喺神父面前立咗誓言，話一定會照顧好屋企人。
